title: Cross-phase dependency tables are incomplete — missing entries for features with earlier-phase dependencies
description: The Phase 3 Cross-Phase Dependencies table listed only 13 of ~21 actual cross-phase dependencies. Missing 8 entries including SP-12→AC-8 (Phase 1, RBAC), SP-15→EM-7 (Phase 1, employee scoping), SP-17→SP-18/SP-21/SP-31 (Phase 2, keyword engine), SP-25→AM-16 (Phase 2, workflow definitions), and others. Bootstrap uses cross-phase deps to define interface contracts.
root_cause: The manifest generation step checks each feature's direct dependencies to see if they resolve to an earlier phase, but misses transitive dependencies that cross phase boundaries. Features whose canonical deps are in the same phase but which ALSO have transitive deps on earlier-phase features are not caught.
recommendation: In Phase 3.3 manifest generation, when building the Cross-Phase Dependencies table, check EVERY dependency edge (direct from Feature Summary Table) for each feature. For each dependency that resolves to a feature in an earlier phase, add an entry. Also check if the initiative document lists additional cross-phase dependencies beyond direct ones (e.g., Section 9.3/9.4 cross-references).
affected_phase: Phase 3.3 — Generate Phase Manifests — Cross-Phase Dependencies table
